limits: Covers only the deterministic pad/CRC/length tail; the preceding BINH stage-1 block header/code and the following stage-2 XIP text remain separate, still-opaque spans.

The CRC-32/MPEG-2 trailer and XIP length word are format bookkeeping, independently recomputed here from the public BINH algorithm; they are not a claim of redistribution rights over the surrounding still-proprietary block content that the checksum covers.
